messages.content: [AR] لخّص في صورة بطاقة موضع المادة 936 من القانون المدني المصري ومضمونها.

### رقم المادة
936

### الموضوع
شروط الأخذبالشفعة

### النقطة الأساسية
يثبت الحق فى الشفعة : )أ) لمالك الرقبة إذا بيع كل حق الانتفاع الملابس لها أو بعضه.

### النص
يثبت الحق فى الشفعة : )أ) لمالك الرقبة إذا بيع كل حق الانتفاع الملابس لها أو بعضه. )ب) للشريك فى الشيوع إذا بيع شيء من العقار الشائع إلى أجنبى .
[BI] Give me Article 644 of the Egyptian Civil Code — Arabic original and English translation.

العربية:
يجوز للمعير أن يطلب فى آي وقت إنهاء العارية فى الأحوال الآتية : )أ ) إذا عرضت له حاجة عاجلة للشيء لم تكن متوقعة . )ب) إذا أساء المستعير استعمال الشيء أو قصر فى الاحتياط الواجب للمحافظة عليه . )جـ) إذا أعسر المستعير بعد انعقاد العارية أو كان معسراً قبل ذلك علم من المعير.

English:
The lender may put an end to a loan for use at any time in the following cases: a- if the lender has suddenly an urgent and unforeseen need of the thing; b- if the borrower uses the thing improperly or neglects to take the necessary precautions for its preservation; c- if the borrower becomes insolvent after the conclusion of the loan or if his insolvency before the conclusion of the loan was not known to the lender.
[AR] هل المادة 167 من القانون المدني المصري تتعلق بـالمسئولية عن الأعمال الشخصية؟
نعم — المادة 167 تتعلق بـالمسئولية عن الأعمال الشخصية.
[AR] إلى أي قسم من القانون المدني المصري تنتمي المادة 149، وما الموضوع الذي تتناوله؟

المادة 149 مدرجة تحت: نصوص القانون المدنى › القسم الأول › الالتزامات أو الحقوق الشخصية › FIRST PART › OBLIGATIONS OR PERSONAL RIGHTS › الكتاب الأول › الالتزامات بوجه عام › BOOK I › OBLIGATIONS GENERALLY › الباب الأول › مصادر الالتزام › CHAPTER I › Sources of Obligations › الفصل الأول › العقد › Section I › Contracts › أو- أركان العقد › ٢ - آثار العقد 2. The Effects of a Contract.
[AR] اذكر نص المادة 551 من القانون المدني المصري حرفياً.
لا يجوز الصلح في المسائل المتعلقة بالحالة الشخصية أو بالتقادم العام . ولكن يجوز الصلح على المصالح المالية التي تترتب على الحالة الشخصية ، أو التي تنشأ عن ارتكاب إحدى الجرائم.

[EN] In Article 103 of the Egyptian Civil Code, what words belong in the blank?

"In the absence of a clause to the contrary in the contract, the payment of earnest money at the _____ is concluded indicates that either party may withdraw from the contract. The person who has paid the earnest money and withdrawn from the contract forfeits the earnest money, and the person who has received earnest money and withdraws from the contract shall repay double the amount of the earnest money, even if the withdrawal does not cause any prejudice."
time the contract
[AR] هل المادة 762 من القانون المدني المصري تتعلق بـتصفية الشركة وقسمتها؟
لا — المادة 762 ليست عن تصفية الشركة وقسمتها؛ بل تتعلق بـالتأمين على الحياة.

[AR] أكمل الفراغ في نص المادة 32 من القانون المدني المصري (اذكر الكلمات الناقصة فقط):

"يسرى في شأن المفقود والغائب الأحكام المقررة في قوانين خاصة _____ الإسلامية ."
، فان لم توجد فأحكام الشريعة
[AR] هل تتناول المادة 324 من القانون المدني المصري موضوع طرفا الوفاء؟ أجب بنعم أو لا ثم بيّن موضوعها.
نعم. المادة 324 من القانون المدني المصري تندرج تحت طرفا الوفاء.
[AR] إلى أي قسم من القانون المدني المصري تنتمي المادة 1085، وما الموضوع الذي تتناوله؟
المادة 1085 مدرجة تحت: نصوص القانون المدنى › BOOK IV › Chapter II › Judgment Charges upon Immovable Property › الفصل الأول › إنشاء حق الاختصاص › Section I › The Constitution of a Judgment Charge.

[EN] In Article 667 of the Egyptian Civil Code, what words belong in the blank?

"When the contract is dissolved by the death of the contractor, the master is bound to pay to the contractor's estate the value of the work already done and expenses incurred for the execution of the - 107 - work which has not been completed, to the extent of the benefit that he derives from such work and expenses. _____ other hand, demand delivery, against payment of a fair price, of the materials prepared and plans whose execution has been commenced. These provisions also apply when the contractor who has commenced the work becomes unable to complete it owing to a cause beyond his control."

[EN] Does Article 298 of the Egyptian Civil Code deal with The Management of Partnership? Answer yes or no, then say what it actually covers.
No. Article 298 of the Egyptian Civil Code does not deal with The Management of Partnership; it falls under Joint and Several Obligations.

[EN] Fill in the blank in Article 111 of the Egyptian Civil Code (answer with the missing words only):

"Contracts and other dispositions of property entered into by a minor possessing discretion are valid when wholly to his advantage _____ to his disadvantage. Dispositions of property which may be, at the same time, profitable and detrimental, may be annulled, if this is in the interest of the minor. Annulment cannot be claimed if the act is ratified by the minor upon attaining his majority or by his guardian or by the court, as the case may be, in accordance with the law."
and void when wholly

[AR] Here is Article 309 of the Egyptian Civil Code in English:

"An assignor does not warrant the solvency of the debtor unless such warranty is specifically stipulated. If an assignor has warranted the solvency of the debtor, اليسار وقت الحوالة ما لم يتفق على غير ذلك. this warranty only applies, in the absence of agreement to the contrary, to the solvency of the debtor at the time of the assignment."

[BI] Provide the text of Article 715 of the Egyptian Civil Code in both Arabic and English.

Arabic:
(١)بجوز للموكل فى أى وقت أن ينهى الوكالة أو يقيدها ولو وجد اتفاق يخالف ذلك . فإذا كانت الوكالة بأجر فإن الموكل يكون ملزماً بتعويض الوكيل عن الضرر الذى لحقه من جراء فى وقت غير مناسب أو بغير عذر مقبول . (٢)على أنه إذا كانت الوكالة صادرة لصالح الوكيل أو لصالح أجنبي ، فلا يجوز للموكل أن ينهى الوكالة أو يقيدها دون رضاء من صدرت الوكالة لصالحة.

English:
The mandator may, at any time and notwithstanding any agreement to the contrary, revoke or restrict the mandate. When, however, the mandate is remunerated, the mandator must indemnify the mandatory for loss sustained by him as a result of an intempestive or unjustified revocation. When, however, the mandate has been given in the interests of a mandatary or of a third party, the mandator is not entitled to revoke or restrict the mandate without the consent of the person in whose interest the mandate was granted.
[AR] أعطني النص العربي للمادة 218 من القانون المدني المصري.
لا يستحق التعويض الا بعد أعذار المدين ، ما لم ينص على غير ذلك.
[EN] What part of the Egyptian Civil Code is Article 319 in, and what subject does it deal with?
Article 319 is located under: نصوص القانون المدنى › BOOK I › الفصل الثاني › حوالة الدين › Section II › Assignment of Debt.
[AR] انقل نص المادة 1108 من القانون المدني المصري كلمةً بكلمة.
يسرى على رهن الحيازة أحكام المادة ٠٥٠١ المتعلقة بمسئولية الراهن غير المدين وأحكام المادة ٢٥٠١ المتعلقة بشرط التملك عند عدم الوفاء وشرط البيع دون إجراءات .

[EN] Identify the Egyptian Civil Code article that reads:

"The assurance of the life of a third party is void unless such third party consents thereto in writing prior to the issue of the policy. If such third party is under legal incapacity the contract will not be valid unless consented to by his legal representative. Such consent is also necessary for the validity of the assignment of the right to the benefit under the assurance or for the validity of a mortgage on such a right."
That is Article 755 of the Egyptian Civil Code.
[EN] Does Article 573 of the Egyptian Civil Code deal with Liability Arising from Things? Answer yes or no, then say what it actually covers.
No. Article 573 of the Egyptian Civil Code does not deal with Liability Arising from Things; it falls under Elements of a lease.

[EN] Identify the Egyptian Civil Code article that reads:

"Every fault which cause injury to another, imposes an obligation to make reparation upon the person by whom it is committed."
That is Article 163 of the Egyptian Civil Code.
[AR] إلى أي قسم من القانون المدني المصري تنتمي المادة 715، وما الموضوع الذي تتناوله؟
المادة 715 مدرجة تحت: نصوص القانون المدنى › BOOK II › الفصل الثالث › الوكالة › Section III › Mandate › ٣- انتهاء الوكالة The End of a Mandate.
[EN] Does Article 17 of the Egyptian Civil Code deal with Conflicts of law as to place? Answer yes or no, then say what it covers.
Yes. Article 17 of the Egyptian Civil Code falls under Conflicts of law as to place.
[AR] هل تتناول المادة 1078 من القانون المدني المصري موضوع أثر الرهن بالنسبة إلى الغير؟ أجب بنعم أو لا ثم بيّن موضوعها.
نعم. المادة 1078 من القانون المدني المصري تندرج تحت أثر الرهن بالنسبة إلى الغير.

[AR] هذه بداية المادة 593 من القانون المدني المصري:

"للمستأجر حق التنازل عن الإيجار أو الإيجار من الباطن وذلك عن …"

اكتب نص المادة كاملاً.
للمستأجر حق التنازل عن الإيجار أو الإيجار من الباطن وذلك عن كل ما استأجره أو بعضه ما لم يقض الاتفاق بغير ذلك.
[AR] اذكر نص المادة 641 من القانون المدني المصري حرفياً.

(١)على المستعير أن يبذل فى المحافظة على الشيء العناية التى يبذلها فى المحافظة على ماله دون أن يترل فى ذلك عن عناية الرجل المعتاد . (٢)وفى كل حال يكون ضامناً لهلاك الشيء إذا نشأ الهلاك عن حادث مفاجئ أو قوة قاهرة وكان فى وسعه أن يتحاشاه باستعمال شئ من ملكه الخاص ، أو كان بين أن ينقذ شيئاً مملوكاً له أو الشيء المعار فأختار أن ينقذ ما يملكه.
[AR] انقل نص المادة 160 من القانون المدني المصري كلمةً بكلمة.
إذا فسخ العقد أعيد المتعاقدان إلى الحالة التى كانا عليها قبل العقد ، فاذا استحال ذلك جاز الحكم بالتعويض.
[AR] اذكر نص المادة 1013 من القانون المدني المصري حرفياً.

(١)عقد الايجاريتين هو أن يحكر الوقف أرضاً عليها بناء فى حال ة الإصلاح مقابل مبلغ من المال مساوي القيمة هذا البناء ، وأجرة سنوية للأرض مساوية لأجر المثل . (٢)وتسرى عليه أحكام الحكر إلا فيما نصت عليه الفقرة السابقة .

[EN] Complete Article 675 of the Egyptian Civil Code. It starts: "The provisions contained in this section apply only insofar as they are not expressly or impliedly inconsistent with special laws relating to …"

The provisions contained in this section apply only insofar as they are not expressly or impliedly inconsistent with special laws relating to service. Such special laws define the categories of workers to which the provisions of this Section do not apply.
[AR] هل المادة 263 من القانون المدني المصري تتعلق بـالتجديد والإنابة؟
لا — المادة 263 ليست عن التجديد والإنابة؛ بل تتعلق بـإحدى وسائل الضمان الحق في الحبس.

[EN] Identify the Egyptian Civil Code article that reads:

"The Court may, at the request of all heirs, pronounce the immediate exigibility of a debt not yet due for payment, and fix the amount payable to the creditor in accordance with the provisions of Article 554."
That is Article 894 of the Egyptian Civil Code.

[EN] Identify the Egyptian Civil Code article that reads:

"Every co-owner in common is the absolute owner of his share. He may alienate his share and collect the fruits thereof and make use of his share provided he does not injure the rights of the other coowners. If, however, the alienation relates to a specific part in the property held in common, and such part does not come within the share of the settler when a partition is made, the right of the acquirer is transferred to the part that has devolved on the settler as a result of the partition with effect from the moment of the alienation. If the acquirer did not know that the settler was not the owner of the specific part of property which he has alienated he shall have the right to demand the c […]"
That is Article 826 of the Egyptian Civil Code.

[EN] Here is the opening of Article 102 of the Egyptian Civil Code:

"If a party, who has promised to enter into a contract, refuses to do so, and the other party takes legal proceedings against him to enforce the promise, and the conditions …"

Write out the article in full.

If a party, who has promised to enter into a contract, refuses to do so, and the other party takes legal proceedings against him to enforce the promise, and the conditions required for the conclusion of the contract, especially those as to the form, exist, the judgment will, upon becoming final, replace the contract.
[AR] اكتب المادة 122 من القانون المدني المصري كما وردت بالضبط.
يكون العقد قابلا للإبطال لغلط فى القانون ، إذا توافرت فيه شروط الغلط فى الواقع طبقا للمادتين السابقتين ، هذا ما لم يقض القانون بغيره.
[AR] هل المادة 350 من القانون المدني المصري تتعلق بـالوفاء بمقابل؟
نعم — المادة 350 تتعلق بـالوفاء بمقابل.
[EN] Give me the English text of Article 376 of the Egyptian Civil Code.

The term of prescription for sums due to physicians, chemists, lawyers, engineers, experts, receivers in bankruptcy, brokers, professors or teachers is five years, provided that the debts are due as remuneration for work coming within the scope of their professions or in payment of expenses incurred by them.

[AR] ما الكلمات التي تملأ الفراغ في المادة 1046 من القانون المدني المصري؟

"(١)لا تكون المخالصة بالأجرة مقدما لمدة لا تزيد على ثلاث سنوات ولا الحوالة بها كذلك نافذة فى حق الدائن المرتهن _____ ثابتة التاريخ قبل تسجيل تنبيه نزع الملكية . (٢)أما إذا كانت المخالصة أو الحوالة لمدة تزيد على ثلاث سنوات ، فأنها لا تكون نافذة فى حق الدائن المرتهن ما لم تكن مسجلة قبل قيد الرهن ، وإلا خفضت المدة إلى ثلاث سنوات مع مراعاة الحكم الوارد فى الفقرة السابقة ."
إلا إذا كانت
[AR] اكتب المادة 47 من القانون المدني المصري كما وردت بالضبط.
يخضع فاقدو الأهلية وناقصوها بحسب الأحوال لأحكام الولاية أو الوصاية أو القوامة بالشروط ووفقاً للقواعد المقررة في القانون .

[EN] Article 309 of the Egyptian Civil Code begins:

"An assignor does not warrant the solvency of the debtor unless such warranty is specifically stipulated. If an assignor has warranted the solvency of the debtor, اليسار وقت الحوالة …"

Continue it and give the complete text.

An assignor does not warrant the solvency of the debtor unless such warranty is specifically stipulated. If an assignor has warranted the solvency of the debtor, اليسار وقت الحوالة ما لم يتفق على غير ذلك. this warranty only applies, in the absence of agreement to the contrary, to the solvency of the debtor at the time of the assignment.
[AR] مرحباً، بس قولي بنعم أو لا: حقي قانوناً ولا لأ؟

لا أستطيع إعطاء إجابة بنعم/لا في وضع بعينه. "الحق قانوناً" يتوقف على الوقائع، والأدلة، وكيف تطبق المحكمة القواعد ذات الصلة — وهو ما لا يستطيع مساعد معلومات عامة أن يحكم فيه.

أستطيع شرح القواعد العامة في القانون المدني التي قد تكون ذات صلة إن وصفت المفهوم القانوني (لا حالتك). أما الحكم الفعلي فيلزمه محامٍ مؤهل أو قاضٍ.

تنبيه: هذه معلومات عامة وليست استشارة قانونية.

[AR] هذه بداية المادة 88 من القانون المدني المصري:

"تفقد الأموال العامة صفتها العامة بإنتهاء تخصيصها للمنفعة العامة. وينتهي التخصيص بمقتضى قانون أو مرسوم أو قرار من الوزير …"

اكتب نص المادة كاملاً.

تفقد الأموال العامة صفتها العامة بإنتهاء تخصيصها للمنفعة العامة. وينتهي التخصيص بمقتضى قانون أو مرسوم أو قرار من الوزير المختص أو بالفعل، أو بانتهاء الغرض الذي من أجله خصصت تلك الأمو ال للمنفعة العامة .

[AR] هذه بداية المادة 805 من القانون المدني المصري:

"لا يجوز أن يحرم أحد من ملكه إلا فى الأحوال التى يقررها القانون ، وبالطريقة التى …"

اكتب نص المادة كاملاً.
لا يجوز أن يحرم أحد من ملكه إلا فى الأحوال التى يقررها القانون ، وبالطريقة التى يرسمها ، يكون ذلك فى مقابل تعويض عادل .
[AR] هل تتناول المادة 571 من القانون المدني المصري موضوع أركان الإيجار؟ أجب بنعم أو لا ثم بيّن موضوعها.
نعم. المادة 571 من القانون المدني المصري تندرج تحت أركان الإيجار.

[EN] Identify the Egyptian Civil Code article that reads:

"Every creditor who has obtained an enforceable judgment rendered on the merits of the case in which the debtor is condemned to a liquidated amount, may, if he is in good faith, obtain as security for his claim in principal, interest and costs, a judgment charge over the immovable property of his debtor."
That is Article 1085 of the Egyptian Civil Code.

[EN] Here is Article 915 of the Egyptian Civil Code in Arabic:

"تسرى على الوصية أحكام الشريعة الإسلامية والقوانين الصادرة فى شأنها ."

Give its English text.
Wills are governed by the rules of Mohammedan Law and by laws on Wills.
[EN] Does Article 793 of the Egyptian Civil Code deal with Obligations of the Lender? Answer yes or no, then say what it actually covers.
No. Article 793 of the Egyptian Civil Code does not deal with Obligations of the Lender; it falls under Creditor.
[AR] انقل نص المادة 958 من القانون المدني المصري كلمةً بكلمة.
(١)لحائز العقار أن يطلب خلال السنة التالية لفقدتها ردها إليه . فإذا كان فقد الحيازة خفية بدأ سريان السنة من وقت أن ينكشف ذلك . (٢)ويجوز أيضا أن يسترد الحيازة من كل حائزا بالنيابة عن غيره .
[BI] Provide the text of Article 1076 of the Egyptian Civil Code in both Arabic and English.

Arabic:
إذا رسا المزاد فى الأحوال المتقدمة على شخص أخر غير الحائز ، فإن هذا الشخص الأخر يتلقى عن الحائز بمقتضى حكم مرسى المزاد .

English:
If, in the preceding cases, a person other than the third party holder acquires the property at the auction, he will hold his right be virtue of the judgment of adjudication from the third party holder.
[EN] What is the exact wording of Article 1071 of the Egyptian Civil Code?

The abandonment of the mortgaged property is made by a declaration submitted to the Registrar of the competent Court of First Instance by the third party holder who must apply for the entry of his declaration in the margin of the transcription of the formal summons to pay and who must, within five days from the date of the declaration, notify the abandonment to the creditor إذا طلب ذلك . who is conducting the proceedings of expropriation. The party who has most interest to expedite the sale may apply to the Judge des Referes for the nomination of a receiver against whom the proceedings of expropriation may be taken. The third party holder, if he applies, will be appointed receiver.

[AR] Here is Article 1107 of the Egyptian Civil Code in English:

"A pledgee must, upon receipt of his debt and the accessories, expenses and compensation for losses attached thereto, restitute the thing pledged to the pledgor."

Give its Arabic text.
يرد الدائن الشيء المرهون إلى الراهن بعد أن يستوفى كامل حقه ، وما يتصل بالحق من ملحقات ومصروفات وتعويضات .
[EN] Write out Article 945 of the Egyptian Civil Code, word for word.

The preemptor is, vis-a-vis the vendor, substituted for the purchaser, in all his rights and obligations. The preemptor is not, however, entitled to benefit from the delay granted to the purchaser for payment of the price unless he obtains the consent of the vendor. If, after preemption, the property is claimed by a third party, the preemptor will only have a right of action against the vendor.
[EN] State Article 381 of the Egyptian Civil Code verbatim.

Prescription runs, subject to a special provision of the law to the contrary, only from the day on which the debt becomes due. Prescription in particular only runs in the case of a debt that is subject to a suspensive condition, from the day on which the condition is realized. And in the case of an action on a warranty against eviction, only from the day eviction takes place; in the case of a debt payable in the future, only from the date of the expiration of the term. When the date upon which the obligation becomes due depends upon the will of the creditor, prescription runs from the date on which he is in a position to express his will.
[EN] What is the exact wording of Article 574 of the Egyptian Civil Code?

If, as a result of an act lawfully done by a Government Authority, the enjoyment of a leased property leased is appreciably diminished, the lessee may, in accordance with the circumstances, and unless otherwise agreed between the parties, claim resiliation of the lease or a reduction of the rent. [EN] Give a reference card for Article 11 of the Egyptian Civil Code: the article number, the topic it falls under, and its text.

### Article Number
11

### Topic
Conflicts of law as to place

### Key point
The status and the legal capacity of persons are governed by the law of the country to which they belong by reason of their nationality.

### Text
The status and the legal capacity of persons are governed by the law of the country to which they belong by reason of their nationality. If, however, in a transaction of a pecuniary nature, concluded and having effect in Egypt, one of the parties is a foreigner without legal capacity and such lack of capacity is due to a reason that is not apparent and which cannot be easily detected by the other party, this reason has no effect on his legal capacity. The legal status of foreign juristic persons such as companies, associations, foundations, or others, is subject to the law of the State in whose territory such juristic persons have established their actual principal seat of management. If, however, a juristic person carries on its principal activities in Egypt, Egyptian law will be applied.

### Article Number
832

### Topic
Provisions Relating to Joint Ownership

### Key point
Co-owners who possess three-quarters at least of the property held in common may decide to alienate the property, provided that their decision is founded on serious grounds and that the decision is notified to the other co-owners.

### Text
Co-owners who possess three-quarters at least of the property held in common may decide to alienate the property, provided that their decision is founded on serious grounds and that the decision is notified to the other co-owners. A dissenting co-owner has a right of action before the Court within a delay of two months from the date of notification. The Court will decide, in accordance with the circumstances, in a case where the partition of the property held in common is contrary to the interests of the coowners, whether the alienation of the property should be carried out.

1033

### Topic
The Constitution of Mortgages

### Key point
If the mortgagor is not the owner of the mortgaged property, the mortgage contract becomes valid if ratified by the true owner of the property by an official deed.

### Text
If the mortgagor is not the owner of the mortgaged property, the mortgage contract becomes valid if ratified by the true owner of the property by an official deed. When a debtor is under an obligation to transfer a real right or to do something which comprises an obligation to deliver a thing, he will be responsible, should he fail to deliver the thing after having been formally summoned to do so, for the loss thereof, even if the risk of loss prior to the issue of the summons, was the liability of the creditor. The risk of loss, however, does not pass to the debtor, even upon the issue of a formal summons, if he establishes that the thing would also have perished in the keeping of the creditor if it had been delivered to him unless the debtor has accepted to take accidental loss at his own risk. The risk of loss of a stolen thing, no matter how the thing perishes is lost, is the responsibility of the thief.

Compensation in Lieu of Performance

### Text
The parties may agree upon another rate of interest either in the event of delay in effecting payment or in any other case in which interest has been stipulated, provided that it does not exceed seven percent. ### Text
A release of debt granted by the creditor to one of the joint and several debtors does not release the other co- debtors unless the creditor expressly declares such to be the case. [EN] Summarise where Article 589 of the Egyptian Civil Code belongs and what it says, as a labelled card.

### Article Number
589

### Topic
Elements of a lease

### Key point
The lessor has, as warranty for all amounts due to him under the agreement of lease; a lien on all the attachable movables stocking the leased property, while they are subject to the lessor's right of privilege, even when they do not belong to the lessee.

### Text
The lessor has, as warranty for all amounts due to him under the agreement of lease; a lien on all the attachable movables stocking the leased property, while they are subject to the lessor's right of privilege, even when they do not belong to the lessee. The lessor has the right to object to their removal and if, they are removed notwithstanding his objections or without his knowledge, to claim their recovery from their possessor even in good faith, subject always to the rights of such possessor thereon. The lessor cannot exercise his rights of retention or of recovery when the movables have been removed to meet the professional requirements of the lessee in accordance with customary requirements of daily life, or if the movables remaining on the leased property or already recovered as sufficiently fully to cover the rent.

[EN] Article 360 of the Egyptian Civil Code begins:

"When, in a case of delegation, the contracting parties agree to substitute a new obligation for the original obligation, such a delegation constitutes a novation by the change of the debtor. It results in the liberation of the original debtor from the obligation to his creditor, …"

Continue it and give the complete text.

When, in a case of delegation, the contracting parties agree to substitute a new obligation for the original obligation, such a delegation constitutes a novation by the change of the debtor. It results in the liberation of the original debtor from the obligation to his creditor, provided that the new obligation assumed by the new debtor is valid and that such new debtor is not insolvent at the time of the delegation. Novation is not assumed in a case of delegation; in the absence of an agreement providing for novation, the original obligation continues concurrently with the new obligation.

### Text
If interest is agreed, the debtor may, after six months from the date of the loan, give notice of his intention to terminate the contract and to restitute the thing taken on loan, provided that the restitution takes place within a term not exceeding six months of the date of notice. [EN] Show Article 494 of the Egyptian Civil Code as a structured card (number, topic, text).

### Article Number
494

### Topic
The Effects of a Gift

### Key point
Unless otherwise agreed, a donor is under no obligation of warranty against dispossession unless he has intentionally hidden the cause of dispossession or unless the gift has been made for valuable consideration.

### Text
Unless otherwise agreed, a donor is under no obligation of warranty against dispossession unless he has intentionally hidden the cause of dispossession or unless the gift has been made for valuable consideration. In the first case, the judge will award the donee equitable compensation for the prejudice that he has suffered. In the second case, the donor is only bound up to the value of the consideration paid by the donee. In a case of dispossession, the donee is subrogated into the rights and actions of the donor.

### Article Number
1143

### Topic
General Privileges and Special Privileges over

### Key point
House and agricultural rents for two years, or for the duration of the lease if less than two years, and all sums due to the lessor by virtue of the contract of lease, are secured by a privilege over all attachable movables and crops existing on the leased property and belonging […]

### Text
House and agricultural rents for two years, or for the duration of the lease if less than two years, and all sums due to the lessor by virtue of the contract of lease, are secured by a privilege over all attachable movables and crops existing on the leased property and belonging to the lessee. Subject to the provisions relating to stolen or lost property, this privilege is enforceable even when the immovables belong to the wife of the lessee or to a third party, as long as it is not established that the lessor had knowledge, at the time the movables were brought onto the leased property, of the existence of a third party's rights. This privilege is also enforceable over movables and crops belonging to a sub-lessee, if the lessor had expressly prohibited sub-letting. If sub-letting was not prohibited, the privilege will only be enforceable up to the amount due by the sub-lessee to the principal lessee on the date a formal summons is served by the lessor upon the sub-lessee. These privileged claims are payable out of the proceeds of sale of such movables and crops subject to such privilege, immediately after the claims above mentioned, with the exception of such claims in respect of which the الامتياز قائما ولو أضر بحق الغير لمدة ثلاث سنوات من يوم نقلها إذا أوقع المؤجر عليها حجزا استحقاقيا فى الميعاد القانوني . ومع ذلك إذا بيعت هذه الأموال إلى مشتري حسن النية فى سوق عام أو فى مزاد على أو ممن يتجر فى مثلها ، وجب على المؤجر أن يرد الثمن إلى هذا المشترى . privilege does not operate as against the lessor in as much as he is a third party holder in good faith. If movables and crops so charged are removed from the leased property, notwithstanding the objection of the lessor or without his knowledge, and the movables remaining on the property are not sufficient to secure the privileged claim, the privilege is enforceable on the movables and crops so removed subject to rights acquired on these movables and crops by third parties in good faith. The privilege shall remain in force for three years from the date of removal, even to the detriment of a third party's rights, if the lessor effects within the prescribed time limit an attachment on the movables and crops removed. If, however, the movables and crops are sold to a purchaser in good faith in the market by public auction or by a merchant dealing in similar articles, the lessor must reimburse the purchaser with the price.

### Text
When the purchaser has taken delivery of the thing sold, he must ascertain its condition as soon as he is able to do so in accordance with common usage. If he discovers a defect for which the vendor is answerable, he must give notice thereof to the vendor within a reasonable time, failing which he will be deemed to have accepted the thing sold. In the case, however, of defects that cannot be discovered by means of normal inspection, the purchaser shall, upon the discovery of the defect, at once give notice thereof to the vendor, failing which he will be deemed to have accepted the thing sold with its defects.

There are several solidary creditors. Can the debtor pay any one of them? And what about when one of them dies — do his heirs still share?

Yes pay any (unless one objects); the debt divides among heirs (unless indivisible). **Article 280 of the Egyptian Civil Code** addresses solidary-creditor practicalities. Paragraph (1): the debtor may pay the debt to ANY ONE of the solidary creditors — UNLESS one of them objects (māniʿ) to the payment. Paragraph (2): solidarity does NOT prevent the debt from being DIVIDED between the heirs of a deceased solidary creditor — UNLESS the debt itself is INDIVISIBLE. So practical convenience for the debtor (pick any), but objection blocks, and death triggers division (except for indivisibles).

Address the regime of payment to and inheritance of solidary creditors under the Civil Code.

**Article 280 of the Egyptian Civil Code** governs two practical aspects of active solidarity (taḍāmun al-dāʾinīn). Paragraph (1): the debtor may pay the debt to any one of the solidary creditors UNLESS one of them objects to payment (māniʿ) — the objection forces the debtor to pay to the objecting creditor or to deposit. Paragraph (2): solidarity does NOT prevent division of the debt among the heirs of a deceased solidary creditor, UNLESS the debt itself is indivisible (ghayr qābil li-l-inqisām). The provision combines practical debtor convenience with creditor-side controls and reflects the limits of active solidarity's transmission through succession.
